title: LeapAhead! Online Summer Program
text:
LeapAhead! is an online summer math program for students entering grades 3-9. LeapAhead! Gifted is a gifted version of the program for students entering grades 3-7. The program offers 4 assignments a week over 8 weeks during the summer. The online worksheets are interactive and students get immediate feedback as to whether they are right or wrong.

LeapAhead! is aligned with the Common Core State Standards.

The cost for summer 2014 is $24.95 for the first child, with a sibling discount of $19.95 per child. The group pricing is $100.00 for 10 students.

You can find out more about the LeapAhead! summer program at its website: http://www.noetic-learning.com/summermath/
